fact: In patients with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction and obesity, tirzepatide reduced the combined risk of cardiovascular death or worsening heart failure with a hazard ratio of 0.62 (95% CI, 0.41–0.95; P =0.026).
fact_zh: 在患有射血分数保留型心力衰竭和肥胖的患者中，替西帕肽降低了心血管死亡或心力衰竭恶化的综合风险，风险比为0.62（95% CI，0.41–0.95；P =0.026）。
sec: Results / Effect of Tirzepatide on Outcomes
quote: tirzepatide reduced the risk of the composite of cardiovascular death or worsening HF events (hazard ratio, 0.62 [95% CI, 0.41–0.95]; P =0.026)

fact: Compared with placebo, tirzepatide increased the Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire Clinical Summary Score by 6.9 points (95% CI, 3.3–10.6; P <0.001) at 52 weeks.
fact_zh: 与安慰剂相比，替西帕肽在52周时使堪萨斯城心肌病问卷临床总分提高了6.9分（95% CI，3.3–10.6；P <0.001）。
quote: At 52 weeks, tirzepatide increased the Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire Clinical Summary Score by 6.9 points (95% CI, 3.3–10.6; P <0.001)

fact: Compared with placebo, tirzepatide increased the 6-minute walk distance by 18.3 meters (95% CI, 9.9–26.7; P <0.001) at 52 weeks.
fact_zh: 与安慰剂相比，替西帕肽在52周时使6分钟步行距离增加了18.3米（95% CI，9.9–26.7；P <0.001）。
quote: At 52 weeks, tirzepatide increased the Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire Clinical Summary Score by 6.9 points (95% CI, 3.3–10.6; P <0.001), 6-minute walk distance 18.3 meters (95% CI, 9.9–26.7; P <0.001)

fact: Compared with placebo, tirzepatide increased the EQ-5D-5L health state index by 0.06 (95% CI, 0.03–0.09; P <0.001) at 52 weeks.
fact_zh: 与安慰剂相比，替西帕肽在52周时使EQ-5D-5L健康状态指数提高了0.06（95% CI，0.03–0.09；P <0.001）。
quote: At 52 weeks, tirzepatide increased the Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire Clinical Summary Score by 6.9 points (95% CI, 3.3–10.6; P <0.001), 6-minute walk distance 18.3 meters (95% CI, 9.9–26.7; P <0.001), and EQ-5D-5L 0.06 (95% CI, 0.03–0.09; P <0.001)

fact: Compared with placebo, tirzepatide shifted patients to a more favorable Patient Global Impression of Severity Overall Health score with a proportional odds ratio of 1.99 (95% CI, 1.44–2.76; P <0.001) at 52 weeks.
fact_zh: 与安慰剂相比，替西帕肽在52周时使患者向更优的患者总体健康严重程度评分转移，比例优势比为1.99（95% CI，1.44–2.76；P <0.001）。
quote: The tirzepatide group shifted to a more favorable Patient Global Impression of Severity Overall Health score (proportional odds ratio, 1.99 [95% CI, 1.44–2.76]) and New York Heart Association class (proportional odds ratio, 2.26 [95% CI, 1.54–3.31]; both P <0.001)

fact: Compared with placebo, tirzepatide shifted patients to a more favorable New York Heart Association class with a proportional odds ratio of 2.26 (95% CI, 1.54–3.31; P <0.001) at 52 weeks.
fact_zh: 与安慰剂相比，替西帕肽在52周时使患者向更优的纽约心脏协会功能分级转移，比例优势比为2.26（95% CI，1.54–3.31；P <0.001）。
quote: The tirzepatide group shifted to a more favorable Patient Global Impression of Severity Overall Health score (proportional odds ratio, 1.99 [95% CI, 1.44–2.76]) and New York Heart Association class (proportional odds ratio, 2.26 [95% CI, 1.54–3.31]; both P <0.001)

fact: Compared with placebo, tirzepatide reduced the need for heart failure medications (P =0.015) at 52 weeks.
fact_zh: 与安慰剂相比，替西帕肽在52周时减少了心力衰竭药物的需求（P =0.015）。
quote: The tirzepatide group shifted to a more favorable Patient Global Impression of Severity Overall Health score (proportional odds ratio, 1.99 [95% CI, 1.44–2.76]) and New York Heart Association class (proportional odds ratio, 2.26 [95% CI, 1.54–3.31]; both P <0.001) and required fewer heart failure medications (P =0.015).

fact: Compared with placebo, tirzepatide reduced the risk of worsening heart failure events requiring hospitalization or urgent care with a hazard ratio of 0.41 (95% CI, 0.22–0.75; P =0.004) at 52 weeks.
fact_zh: 与安慰剂相比，替西帕肽在52周时降低了需要住院或紧急护理的心力衰竭恶化事件的风险，风险比为0.41（95% CI，0.22–0.75；P =0.004）。

fact: Compared with placebo, tirzepatide increased the proportion of patients achieving a ≥20-point improvement in the Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire Clinical Summary Score by 47.6% versus 35.2% (odds ratio, 1.82 [95% CI, 1.25–2.65]; P =0.002) at 52 weeks.
fact_zh: 与安慰剂相比，替西帕肽在52周时使患者达到堪萨斯城心肌病问卷临床总分≥20分改善的比例提高了47.6% vs 35.2%（优势比，1.82 [95% CI，1.25–2.65]；P =0.002）。
